The idea behind GLOWE

Jewellery details.
Everyday function.

Created as a concept under the Poh Kong innovation proposal, GLOWE brings jewellery-inspired design into a more accessible everyday accessory.

  • Customisable charms — express your own look.
  • Replaceable strap concept — refresh your style without replacing the whole piece.
  • Reusable by design — keep, repair and restyle for longer.

Concept prototype only. Product availability, materials and official Poh Kong endorsement have not been confirmed.
